Cac nguyen kie thiet kie cua “Kien truc ben veng” – Vi mot thien lai khong carbon” duoc khuyen khich âp duong, bao gom chu chung trong den ho sinh thoi moi truong tu nien, giam luong CO, trong cau doi ho thong qua vieu de sdu thieu quai nang luong, toi uu hoa su doi nang luong tao tai"}, {"bbox": [202, 287, 481, 335], "category": "List-item", "text": "- He thong ha tng khut khuyt (nuoc, nuoc th, rac th ch), ha tng cump cung nang luong sach, ha tng tien luong bo vta toan nho"}, {"bbox": [347, 144, 481, 277], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Phat trien co so ha tng giao thong công và thuc duy diei khi hoa, gom xe buyt duu vta he thong tram sac duong duu tu, khuyen khich cu cung vang doong ngu dana dha phong chuyen sang phou tiem xanh, an toan vmoi truong"}, {"bbox": [347, 287, 481, 355], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Ap duong Internet van vat (IOT), du liu len vna dien toan dam may de quan nang luong thong minh trong cac he thong quay xay duong vta giao thong, giup truc quan hoa thong, kien soat quay dui tai nguyen ca mao nang luong tao thu"}, {"bbox": [202, 368, 481, 543], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [202, 556, 481, 598], "category": "Text", "text": "Một mục tiem quan trong khac cai chien luoc phat trien ben veng oia Vinhomes la phat trien Doi theo Vhi nhân sinh. Mục tiem nay duong thuc thiet thong quai viec kien tao moi truong song thich thap nhalt, thun tiem nhalt, an toan, ben veng vha han phu nho ttho cho ngudan:"}, {"bbox": [202, 612, 481, 704], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Cac tien i, chis nhu bien veng, truong ho, trung tham tiem mai, cong buan, quang truong, sien choi, khu theo, thao vui chui gai, khu vco ca host hoong cong doong duong xay duong trong bán kinh doong, tu ho vta de tiem, dam bao chait luong cuo so chong o cua dui"}, {"bbox": [347, 612, 481, 678], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Cac host doong cong doong duong dya mhnh nai duong de lio so xanh, vmanh vna hien nhalt, kelt noi con nguyen de hoan thien mhnh ghep cuoi cung cho nho doi theo"}, {"bbox": [553, 29, 652, 37], "category": "Page-header", "text": "BÁO CÁO THƯƠNG NIÊN | 2023"}, {"bbox": [661, 29, 759, 37], "category": "Page-header", "text": "BÁO CÁO THƯƠNG NIÊN | 2023"}, {"bbox": [955, 29, 963, 37], "category": "Page-header", "text": "CHƯƠNG 5"}, {"bbox": [971, 29, 979, 37], "category": "Page-header", "text": "17"}, {"bbox": [553, 88, 782, 155], "category": "Section-header", "text": "## Vinhomes trong tham chieu vui 17 mục tiem phat trien ben veng cua Liên hợp quốc"}, {"bbox": [727, 87, 1006, 153], "category": "Text", "text": "Cac host doong kinh doan vha duan cua Vinhomes duoc gian kelt vio Cac Mục tiem Phat trien Ben veng cua Liên hợp quoc (SDGs), thien nho nuk mnh m me oia Vinhomes trong vran de nay. Vinhomes luan chudong xac dinh cac mục tiem thuc vio, du y ca su tham vuan som mua giai phat trien thiet kelt ca o bao da cung khac deng phat trien doong kinh doan phu hop vao tam nhin vha chien luong ngu nay vha nung buoc dui tien."}, {"bbox": [553, 187, 939, 200], "category": "Section-header", "text": "### Cac host doong tiet biu ca Vinhomes trong tham chieu vui 17 muci tiem phat trien ben veng cua Liên hợp quốc"}, {"bbox": [557, 213, 594, 222], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Mục tiem"}, {"bbox": [816, 213, 897, 222], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Host doong cua Vinhomes"}, {"bbox": [557, 235, 635, 243], "category": "Text", "text": "Xoa ngheo, xoa doi, Giam bai binh deng"}, {"bbox": [557, 245, 633, 275], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [727, 235, 1006, 277], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Voi thuk thi cua doong cua phat trien vha xay duong cac khu doi theo mtiu khap khip Viet Nam. Vinhomes uun tii nus duong nguyen nguyen vati tu co tia phu, gupu nuk dia hoa chui chung cung o Vinhomes, phat trien nguyen nguyen lieu deng cay tien ca rhu nui sdu duong trong tuang lai nang cai nang nuc cao cua nang cung cai. Ngoi ra, ra mui dia ban ho doong. Cong doong uun tii nus duong nguyen nguyen nuc tao cai, tooo nang vien lama vha thuc duy diei tia phu."}, {"bbox": [727, 287, 1006, 329], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Nam 2023, Vinhomes tiem tuc phat trien khai cau nho ca o nup hoap thip thie mng thuc thiet: Happy Home."}, {"bbox": [727, 339, 1006, 415], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Trong nam, Vinhomes di doong gop o cak host doong thien nguyen, xh, ngo ra, ngo ra, Vinhomes con thuc hoap chuong trao xoa deta nata cho huyen Binh Hoa, thinh Viet Ngu vi nui vio 18 tya doong, tia 5.000 suaut a tet o Gvi Vui nguyen nghe huyen Cai Gia vha tio ho doong nui lsua chia ca 650 can nha cho ho ngheo, hoa hoah cinh khong khhan cua nam."}, {"bbox": [727, 425, 848, 433], "category": "Text", "text": "Xem tiem tiet ca Muci an sinh an hoi tr 135"}, {"bbox": [557, 383, 707, 408], "category": "Text", "text": "Cuo so chong khem mhnh, giao duong chait luong, binh deng gdi; tang truong viem vha kinh t 10 muo lanh mhnh"}, {"bbox": [557, 415, 655, 445], "category": "Picture"}, {"bbox": [727, 383, 1006, 425], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Nam 2023, Vinhomes di tia trang thiet bi y t vi vio giai t vi nho 92 tya doong o cak benh vien truan toan cua vta trang nho 19 tya doong chia chui ca cak benh nhiu thu, ca phau thay thuy thay thiet nho thiet ca kinh mliu ho duong."}, {"bbox": [727, 435, 1006, 477], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Vinhomes di tia tr 64 tya doong cho kha hoac cong ngung Viet Nam. 5.100 may thi ca cak tham chieu, trung ho co so tai co cak dia phou khan thien khap ca nuoc chia co diu kien trang bi dui may thi vuan phu vta tyc o day, vha ho bong cai 800 sinh vien."}, {"bbox": [727, 487, 1006, 529], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Tiy lao doong nui chiem 32,4%, trong do nui laon chiem 29,4% trong Ban Giang do cai 28,6%, trong cap nai lny."}, {"bbox": [727, 539, 1006, 581], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Diu kien viem viem cho nho lao doong tung buoc doan chien; ho tio ca bva nuo me bong bisa me, nhanh vna cung thien vran gia diu duong cung cai cach dich vuan cham soc chhe va bao hiem."}, {"bbox": [727, 591, 1006, 633], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Thuc hoan duy de cak quynh live ched che thai san, nuoie duu dui 12 thu tu, tqua cach mung nho Phu nui Viet Nam, Quoc tay Phu nui, Ngo ra, Vinhomes di kiet hop vui Tap tien Bao hiem Bao Viet Nam. Bao hiem Diu kien de lio xay duong vna trien khai cai chuong trang, goi bao hiem suc khoe vha vien trang re cai CBVN Vinhomes."}, {"bbox": [727, 643, 1006, 685], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Vinhomes dam bao tuan thuy Luapt Lao doong, kong o lao doong buc cai vha lao doem em."}, {"bbox": [727, 695, 1006, 737], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Vinhomes nay vien tii tuf chic cai chuong trang dia tao nho bao, chuong trinh nang cai nang luong quan lny, budi doong, phat trien khai ngue can."}, {"bbox": [727, 747, 1006, 789], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Nam 2023, Vinhomes tiem tuc duy muci trang doong gop cao cho ngan nha sach nho vi nui 17,4,nghe tya doong. 15 tia tao viem lama cua cak nho 11 nung lao doong voma thui luong binh 17,9 truay doong/thang."}, {"bbox": [727, 799, 1006, 841], "category": "List-item", "text": "- Vinhomes tao chuong chung dga dkin dhiu truan ca hieo diu tci vao ca nha cung cai dia phu.
